worldcombat.skill.memento.summary: Give away everything you are: faint on the spot and leave a remnant that haunts nearby foes, taking several stages of Attack and Sp. Atk until it fades. If no foe is in reach the gift cannot be given and you do not faint.
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.0: Cripple the pack closing in while at low HP
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.1: Trade one life to collapse a key threat's output
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.2: Leave a remnant to keep the pressure at the moment you are doomed
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.0: A target caught by the gift loses %1$s Attack and Sp. Atk stage(s) and grieves for %2$s; the remnant keeps renewing it for those who come near.
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.1: Gift radius %1$s blocks, bursting %4$s remnant motes; the remnant stays for %2$s and takes Attack and Sp. Atk from each non-friendly within %3$s blocks, one by one, until it fades.
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.2: Gathering yourself takes %1$s, with a %2$s cooldown. You only sacrifice yourself when the gift actually reaches at least one foe.
worldcombat.skill.memento.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
The companion only considers giving itself away once its health ratio falls below this value; higher sacrifices sooner, lower keeps it for a truly hopeless moment.
When on, the companion may leave its post to give the gift under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.memento.text.wasted: No one nearby; the gift cannot be given
